story_type: sea turtle cut free from crab pot rigging by a boat crew
hook: This sea turtle was tied up in crab pot rope.
narration: This sea turtle was tangled in crab pot rigging off Longboat Key, Florida.
A Coast Guard boat crew from Station Cortez leaned over the side and grabbed hold.
Loose fishing line can wrap a turtle's flippers and pin it, and sea turtles have to surface to breathe.
Two crewmen held on and worked the rigging loose. [short pause] Almost done, buddy.
outcome: The turtle swam away with no apparent injuries.
title: Sea turtle tangled in crab pot rope
description:
On May 12, 2016, crewmembers from Coast Guard Station Cortez freed a sea turtle tangled in crab pot rigging west of Longboat Key, Florida. The turtle swam away with no apparent injuries.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Seaman Connor Sullivan and Petty Officer 2nd Class Brigitta Lambright, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/463545
